title: 第15章 主仆契约第16章 被人暗中盯上了
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: “你还叫小白，黑不溜秋的，难道是条母的？”
郑元的话让二级吞天蟒不由委屈的不已。
不过兽躯却是在飞速变小着，最后成了一个巴掌般大小，嗖的一下子飞到了郑元手心上。
“主人，这里有宝贝，我带你去看看。”
二级凶兽吞天蟒的声音犹如一个稚嫩的小女孩声音。
“卧槽，早说啊。”
郑元也不由一脸兴奋，突然一个回身。
原来是一道身影从洞口飞了进来，正是城主女儿楚琳，一脸焦急万分之意，在上面等了半天，结果还不见郑公子出来，一时间心里急的不行。
喊话也没有回音，所以楚琳也顺着绳子下来了。
“好可爱的小白……”
如果是刚才的蟒蛇样子，楚琳自然会吓得不行，如今的迷你小蛇却是喜欢的不行。
玉手轻轻抚摸着二级凶兽吞天蟒，一脸笑意盈盈。
唉！
“貌似小爷还没有这条蛇受女人喜欢！”
虽然两人都私下确定关系了，但楚小姐可没见对自己这么亲热。
切！
楚琳白了一眼郑元，俏脸不禁一红。
居然和一条蛇争风吃醋，简直没有男人的风度。
“小白恐怕绝不简单，绝非一条普通的二级凶兽，能够口吐人言。”
“”这么有灵性，还能自动认主，还是主仆契约。”
楚琳虽然没有看出小白有什么不一样的地方，不过认为这条凶兽应该不简单。
“难道这是一条灵兽？”
郑元一喜过后把嘴又闭上了，这绝不可能。
灵兽比凶兽等级要高多了，而且还有天赋神通，开脉境强者绝不是对手，所以一下子否认了。
当然现在最重要的是宝贝，洞穴里面并不是太大，很快就到了里面，下一刻小白嗖的一下子飞了过去。
咔嚓！
一块石头吃了下去，兽躯上的伤痕快速的消失不见了。
一股强大的灵气从岩石峭壁里冒了出来。
灵石！
郑元和楚琳同时喊了出来，两人更是快速的走了过去。
然后用剑在石头上撬了起来，很快就露出了白色的石头。
郑元拿在手里运转功法，一股精纯之力瞬间进入了身体里。
content_en:
"You are still called Xiaobai. Hei Buliuqiu, is it Tiaomu's?"
Zheng Yuan's words made the second-level sky-swallowing python feel aggrieved.
However, the beast's body was shrinking rapidly, and finally became the size of a palm, and suddenly flew into the palm of Zheng Yuan's hand.
"Master, there is a treasure here, I will take you to see it."
The voice of the Level 2 ferocious beast, the Sky-Swallowing Python, was like the voice of an immature little girl.
"Damn it, I told you earlier."
Zheng Yuan couldn't help but look excited and suddenly turned around.
It turned out that a figure flew in from the entrance of the cave. It was Chu Lin, the daughter of the city lord. She waited above for a long time with a very anxious look on her face, but she still didn't see Mr. Zheng coming out, and she felt very anxious for a while.
There was no response even after calling, so Chu Lin also descended along the rope.
"What a cute little Bai..."
If it was the python that looked like just now, Chu Lin would naturally be frightened, but now she likes the mini snake.
The jade hand gently stroked the second-level ferocious beast, the Sky-Swallowing Python, with a smile on his face.
well!
"It seems that I am not as popular with women as this snake!"
Although the two of them have confirmed their relationship in private, Miss Chu has never been so affectionate to her.
cut!
Chu Lin rolled her eyes at Zheng Yuan, and her pretty face couldn't help but blush.
To be jealous of a snake is simply unmanly.
"I'm afraid Xiaobai is anything but simple. He is definitely not an ordinary second-level ferocious beast that can speak human words."
"" He is so spiritual and can automatically recognize his master. It is still a master-servant contract. "
Although Chu Lin didn't see anything different about Xiao Bai, she thought this beast must be something special.
"Is this a spiritual beast? "
Zheng Yuan was overjoyed and closed his mouth again. This was absolutely impossible.
Spiritual beasts are much higher level than ferocious beasts, and they also have innate magical powers. A strong person in the Pulse Opening Realm is no match for him, so he immediately denied it.
Of course, the most important thing now is the treasure. The inside of the cave is not too big. We quickly reached the inside, and the next moment Xiaobai flew over in a whoosh.
Click!
After eating a stone, the scars on the beast's body quickly disappeared.
A powerful spiritual energy emerged from the rocky cliff.
Spiritual stone!
Zheng Yuan and Chu Lin shouted at the same time, and they walked over quickly.
Then he used his sword to pry up the stone, and soon the white stone was revealed.
Zheng Yuan held it in his hand and ran the technique, and a pure power instantly entered his body.
